svg.title: Thermodynamic sea-ice update: algorithm flow
svg.desc: One thermodynamic sea-ice step: the state (surface temperature, SST, ice thickness, snow, compactness and ice mask) gives the snow depth and the effective conductance; a semi-implicit surface-energy equation gives a trial surface temperature that is cut off at the melting point, producing melt energy; snow melts before ice and flooded snow is converted to ice; the ice energy ledger updates the thickness, clipped to zero and to the maximum thickness; compactness grows or shrinks with the thickness change and is thresholded into the binary ice mask, and the updated fields return to the coupler.
svg.text: State carried into the ice step
snow conducts poorly, so more snow lowers
: cut off at the melting point
Snow first: melt it, then turn flooded snow into ice
Ice energy ledger and thickness update
: slab-ocean correction when its trial SST would cross
